weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start to seg2:end stack three regional death RATES (4.6, 21.6 and 23.5 per 100,000) into one bottle labelled '9% of the bottle', '43% of the bottle' and '47% of the bottle'. weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene was classified as a 'share' relationship, but these are per-capita rates, not parts of one whole, so the percentages are invented. The mascot was placed as a bystander, not as the cause of the fill.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Redraw it as a comparison of rates: for example, two figures of the same population size, with Sub-Saharan Africa losing 5x as many as Western Europe, so the 'five times' is visible without any percent-of-whole label. Have Data be the one doing it: he tips the pills or empties the reserve-drug shelf that Africa lacks.
